title: J'y vais, j'en prends deux
summary: Avoid repetition of a place or a quantity while preserving what the pronoun refers to.
objectives: Replace a previously mentioned location with y.
Use en for quantities, retaining the amount.
Distinguish quantities of people from stressed-pronoun personal reference.

sources.label: Le Robert: en, including personal reference; consulted 7 September 2026
Public A2 index: topic-coverage reference only

sections.title: Y points back to a place
paragraphs: Y can replace a previously mentioned location introduced by à, dans, chez, sur and similar expressions. It means 'there' in this use, and normally stands before its verb or auxiliary. It can replace the location chez ma sœur even though that phrase contains a person: y refers to her home. For movement away from a place introduced by de, en is the relevant pronoun instead.

Y also replaces many à + thing complements: penser au problème → y penser. For thinking about a particular person, the normal choice is penser à lui/elle. Do not turn every à phrase into y, especially when the verb calls for lui/leur.
points: Simple: j'y travaille. Compound: j'y ai travaillé. Infinitive object: je veux y travailler. Negative: je n'y travaille pas.

examples.french: La bibliothèque ? J'**y vais** après le travail.
examples.english: The library? I am going there after work.

examples.french: Nous sommes chez ma tante ; nous **y restons** ce soir.
examples.english: We are at my aunt's; we are staying there tonight.
examples.note: Y refers to the place, not to the aunt as an object.

examples.english: That neighbourhood? She wants to live there.
The solution? We are thinking about it.
examples.note: Penser à a thing can use y.

sections.title: En replaces the noun, not the amount
paragraphs: En stands for a noun introduced by a partitive or indefinite quantity: du café → j'en veux; des pommes → j'en achète. With a number or amount word, keep the amount after the verb: j'en prends deux, nous en avons beaucoup. With un/une meaning one, retain it, including its gender. With ordinary negative quantity, j'en ai becomes je n'en ai pas.

En can refer to people in quantified phrases: des collègues, j'en connais plusieurs. It is false that en never represents a person. For a particular person introduced by de, a stressed form is often clearer: je parle d'elle. En can also have personal reference in suitable contexts; do not mark it universally ungrammatical. The exercises specify quantities or a requested stressed form to avoid rejecting legitimate variants.
points: Placement: j'en achète; j'en ai acheté; je vais en acheter; je n'en ai pas acheté.
For returning from a place: je reviens de la banque → j'en reviens. En is not a replacement for a specific definite object: les billets → je les ai, but des billets → j'en ai.

examples.french: Du riz ? J'**en ai** dans le placard.
examples.english: Rice? I have some in the cupboard.

examples.french: Une sœur ? Oui, j'**en ai une**.
examples.english: A sister? Yes, I have one.
examples.note: En can represent a person in a quantity.

examples.french: Des collègues ici ? J'**en connais plusieurs**.
examples.note: The quantified personal reference is ordinary French.

mistakes.why: Keep the number without an extra de.

practice.prompt: Replace au centre: Nous allons au centre. Rewrite.
Replace the repeated noun: Je prends deux pommes. Rewrite with en.
Answer with en and une: Tu as une réservation ? — Oui, ___. Use je.
Replace dans ce quartier: Je veux vivre dans ce quartier. Rewrite.
Replace chez nos amis: Nous avons dormi chez nos amis. Rewrite with y.
practice.explanation: Y refers to their home and precedes the auxiliary.

practice.prompt: Replace au rendez-vous: Elle ne va pas au rendez-vous. Rewrite.
practice.explanation: Y remains before va inside negation.

practice.prompt: Rewrite with en: Nous avons acheté du pain.
Rewrite with en: Il connaît trois médecins.
practice.explanation: En can represent quantified people; retain trois.

practice.prompt: Rewrite with en: Je vais commander six billets.
practice.explanation: En belongs to commander; keep six.

practice.prompt: Rewrite with en: Nous n'avons pas de questions.
practice.explanation: En replaces the negative quantity phrase.

practice.prompt: Replace à ce problème: Je pense à ce problème. Rewrite.
practice.explanation: Y can replace an à + thing complement.

practice.prompt: You are coming back from the bank, not returning there. Supply y or en: La banque ? J'___ reviens.
practice.explanation: For the stated origin, revenir de la banque becomes j'en reviens. J'y reviens would mean returning to the bank instead.

practice.prompt: Use en to avoid repeating noun: Elle a beaucoup d'amis.
practice.explanation: Quantified people can be represented by en.

practice.prompt: Replace ma collègue specifically with a stressed pronoun: Je parle de ma collègue.
practice.explanation: The prompt requests a stressed personal form; it does not assert that personal en is always wrong.

practice.prompt: Supply les or en for all the specific tickets: Les billets ? Je ___ ai.
practice.explanation: A definite object uses les, not quantity en.

practice.prompt: Rewrite with y: Vous travaillez à la mairie.

production_task.prompt: Plan supplies for a meeting at a known location. Say who is going there, what supplies you have and how many more you need.
production_task.model_answer: La rencontre est au centre communautaire. J'y vais à dix heures. Des chaises, nous en avons douze, mais il faut en apporter deux de plus. Du café, j'en ai déjà.
production_task.translation: The meeting is at the community centre. I am going there at ten. We have twelve chairs, but we need to bring two more. I already have some coffee.
rubric: Give a clear place before using y.
Do not confuse a definite object with an unspecified quantity.
